title: Investigation Begins
paragraphs: “Consulting the person in charge before reporting… That’s pretty quick thinking.”
“If they’re guilty, they might escape, so we should act quickly too… Let’s just hope it’s nothing serious.”
“Alright, for now, let’s split up and check the clinic and the church. I still haven’t fully learned the written language… Oh, Gaelion might know something since he wasn’t around that time.”

Lately, we’ve been avoiding bringing the Filolials and Father’s subordinates to the throne room. According to Father, it’s because the Pig King is a bad influence. They’re probably either training or playing in the castle’s garden right now.
“Well then, let’s go.”
“Understood.”
“Gaelion-san… I hope he knows something.”
“Totally unreliable!”
We went to consult the rival.
“Ah! Naofumi, it’s you!”
The rival spotted Father and ran over cheerfully.
“Sakura won’t lose either!”
Not to be outdone, Sakura-chan also came running. A huge cloud of dust was rising.
“I can hear the sound of the air being sliced.”
“It feels like the wind when a train passes by.”
Itsuki and Ren each gave their impressions. How oddly calm they are.
“Motoyasu-sama, welcome back. What shall we do today?”
“Monster hunting? Kou’s been bored lately.”
“It’s just that the waves haven’t been happening recently…”
“Motoyasu-san, you’ve already forgotten.”
“We have a lot to do today.”
“Is that so~?”
Following them, the assistant and the mole appeared. Were they studying? They were carrying books and writing tools.
“What’s going on? Are you going somewhere again?”
“We’ve taken on a request. Gaelion-chan, we wanted to ask if there’s anything in your dragon emperor knowledge that might help.”
“Understood. I’ll use all of Gaelion’s knowledge to answer.”
“Um… Is there a way to distinguish a soul that’s possessing a human?”
When Father asked, the rival seemed to ponder for a moment.

“Soul sight… Someone with the magical aptitude to see souls can see the connection between a living creature and its soul. In a normal possession, the connection is severed, and the body is being controlled, so it’s obvious at a glance.”
“So if we can find someone with that aptitude, we can tell immediately?”
Father muttered, sounding like it might be easier than expected, but the rival shook his head.
Is it not possible?
“Gaelion can tell to some extent too. But there was a time when I couldn’t distinguish it.”
“Huh? When was that…?”
“During the battle in Melromarc, even though another person’s soul had taken over, Gaelion didn’t notice!”
Father slumped his shoulders at the rival’s response. That won’t do. In other words, the pig-loving occult methods and spirit detection can’t distinguish it.
“By the way, some demi-human races can maintain their sense of self for a while even after death—”
“Thank you, Gaelion-chan.”
“Got it!”
The rival looks happy to be praised.
Ugh… Come on! Sakura-chan, show off your knowledge too!
“Hm?”
Ahhhhhhh! Sakura-chan is the laid-back type.
The one in charge of knowledge was actually Midori! Where is Midori?!
“W-what’s wrong?”
The mole asked Father.
“Um, sorry to interrupt your studies.”
“N-no, is there something I can help with?”
“Hmm… Is what I talked about with Gaelion-chan earlier related to this request?”
“Uh… I think it would be better to ask about that at the church…”
“Yeah, I figured.”
“But, I’ve heard stories of such heroes in the legends…”
“Ah, that’s true… If a being claiming to be a god is operating behind the scenes, it’s highly likely they’ve done something similar in the past.”
Father nodded as if satisfied with the mole’s words.
“Alright, we’ll head to the church then. Sakura-chan, Gaelion-chan, could you give us a lift there?”
“Okay~”
“I’ll do my best!”
Sakura-chan and the rival began a fierce game of rock-paper-scissors. They’re deciding fairly who gets to carry Father on their back.
“Rock, rock, rock, go~!”
“Nano nano nano~!”
It’s an intense match.
“Everyone, don’t worry and keep studying happily.”
“Okay!”
Since Father told them not to worry, the mole also nodded seriously.
“In the end, asking at the church seems like the fastest option.”
“Based on Gaelion-san’s explanation, it seems like we just need to check for a normal possession, right?”
“Well, yeah, but… Since it’s not impossible, we should cover all bases.”
“This is getting troublesome…”
Ren let out a sigh.
“Well, well.”

We were taken to the Four Saints Church and consulted with the Pope. While we were at it, we also looked through the church’s secret archives related to the heroes. There seem to be many types of magic recorded there. Though, depending on one’s aptitude, there may be some that can’t be learned.
“Is it a method to distinguish between the rightful owner of a body and someone else? Yes.”
“Yes, I believe the Pope is already aware of the assassins from the waves, but since this pattern is definitely possible, we’re investigating it now.”
“I see…”
Even the Pope groans at such a difficult request.
“At our church, people possessed by demons, monsters, or evil spirits are sometimes brought in, but if it’s difficult to distinguish them at a glance… yes, it becomes a challenge.”
“Ah, so you do handle that kind of work as well.”
“Definitely different from some heretical sects.”

Indeed. Well, I recall that in the quests from when this was still a game, there were situations like that. Back then, it could be handled with holy water created by a healer. And in the end, things could be solved physically.
“Certainly, demons are good at hiding themselves, but since they are extremely weak to holy words and magic, if you target that weakness, their true form will be revealed.”
“What if they’ve overcome that weakness?”
Itsuki prefaced his question by acknowledging that it might be impolite.
“…It would be difficult unless we actually see the demon rampaging.”
“…I see. Thank you. So, if their true identity is revealed, how easy is it to safely separate the possessing demon?”
“That also depends on the situation, but if they can fool the eyes of a clergyman, they must be powerful, so I’d say it would be difficult. Yes.”
This is quite a challenge. Father then switched to another approach.
“Next question. Are there any stories in the legends of the past Four Saints about fighting such enemies?”
Oh, he’s asking the right questions. After considering whether it’s possible or not, he’s now trying to unravel clues from legends.
“I recall that several generations ago, there were some records that almost disappeared… I believe those materials are also stored in that room.”
“Really… If there’s been malicious destruction of records, it’s probably the work of enemies operating long before the waves began, isn’t it?”
“It seems that the church of Faubley took that matter seriously and kept them securely stored.”
“…The problem is whether we can read them.”
We could read the prophecy monument, but the other monuments are written in this world’s language, which makes many of them difficult to decipher. They’re practically ancient texts.
“This world’s writing system has been replaced several times, and sometimes older scripts just vanish suddenly.”
“If they decide that destroying inscriptions on stone is too difficult, they probably resort to destroying culture to prevent people from reading them.”

“…I remember reading a novel like that before… Something about a plague wiping out the traditions of a town, and the new settlers trying to reconstruct it based on guesses… It ended up straying quite far from the truth.”
“Father, can you imagine any likely patterns?”
“Hmm… Maybe something like a tyrant who plunged the world into chaos, and the characters he praised… Would anyone want to use that?”
Itsuki glanced at the Pope, who nodded.
“Looks like that’s bingo.”
“Another possibility is that a great nation declared unification, destroyed the culture of the nations they conquered, ruled for several generations… and erased the past.”
Ah, the Pope nodded again. There sure seems to have been a lot of wars.
Is it because this is another world?
